headerDisplay: Homebridge plugin for AudioControl Concert XR receivers. Powers the unit on/off over the LAN IP control port (default 50000). On the receiver, set **Control** to **IP** and **Standby Mode** to **IP and HDMI ON** so the unit remains reachable while in standby.

name.title: Name
name.description: Plugin instance name shown in the Homebridge log.

host.title: Host / IP Address
host.description: IP address or hostname of the AudioControl Concert receiver. Prefer a static/DHCP reservation.

port.title: Control Port
port.description: TCP port for IP automation control. Default is 50000. Out-of-range values fall back to 50000 at startup.

accessoryName.title: Accessory Name
accessoryName.description: Optional HomeKit display name for the power switch. Defaults to the platform name.

zone.title: Zone
zone.description: Which zone to power. Zone 1 is the main/master zone.

model.title: Model
model.description: Optional model name shown in HomeKit Accessory Information.

refreshRate.title: Refresh Rate (seconds)
refreshRate.description: How often to poll the receiver for power state. Default 90 seconds. Values below 5 fall back to 90; values above 86400 are clamped.
